title: OpenCode
denyMechanism: opencode.json `permission` (bash/edit/webfetch/skill: allow|deny|ask, pattern-based) and per-agent `tools:` map / `permission:` overrides; nothing per skill

listing.budget: skill names + descriptions are embedded in the `skill` tool description
listing.note: the agent loads a skill via skill({name}); `permission.skill` patterns decide allow/deny/ask

degradations.text: skill `allowed-tools` is informational — OpenCode only honours name/description/license/compatibility/metadata
MCP tools are advertised as {server}_{tool}, not mcp__{server}__{tool}; allowlist entries written Claude-style never match
no blocking prompt-time hook; integrity checks are best-effort banners
